title: Trump’s dream of peace in Ukraine now must meet Russian reality
description: The ball is now in Russia’s court. But Russia excels at grabbing the ball, pocketing it and debating the rules of the game before claiming the ball has in fact been stolen clean from them by the other team.

title: 'Calling Moscow's bluff': Sky News correspondents' views as Ukraine accepts ceasefire deal
description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said he accepted a 30-day ceasefire agreement brokered by the US following talks in Saudi Arabia - but will Russia accept it?

title: Trump’s Ukraine Minerals Deal Makes Sense
description: In an about-face after their Oval Office fight, the economic partnership is an incentive to push for Russia for peace.

title: What's in the US-proposed Russia and Ukraine ceasefire deal?
description: US and Ukrainian officials met in Saudi Arabia to discuss ending the war with Russia. After nine hours of talks, Volodymyr Zelenskyy said his country is ready to support a 30-day ceasefire. But what is the US proposing?

title: EU's top diplomat pledges unified support for Ukraine and global humanitarian aid in dig at US
description: UNITED NATIONS (AP) — The European Union has a message for the Trump administration: It will continue supporting Ukraine against Russia’s illegal invasion, step up humanitarian aid when others pull

title: Ukraine accepts U.S. proposal for 30-day ceasefire with Russia
description: The U.S. has agreed to restore aid and intelligence sharing with Kyiv; it’s unclear whether Russia would agree to the deal

title: Ukraine agrees to ceasefire with Russia as Donald Trump view now clear
description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the US would present the ceasefire offer to the Kremlin

title: Dizzying turnaround in US-Ukraine relations leaves all eyes on Russia
description: For the first time, Moscow is being asked to make a commitment, though it is unclear what will follow if it does sign up

title: U.S. Stock Market Wobbles Amid Tariff Turbulence and Global Tensions
description: U.S. stocks dipped on Tuesday amid trade tensions and geopolitical developments. President Trump's tariffs impacted market sentiment, causing significant market corrections. A potential peace deal between Ukraine and Russia offered hope. U.S. stocks showed volatility with losses in various sectors, alongside increasing job openings but consumer sentiment sliding.

title: U.S.-Ukraine Aid Resumes Amid Tense Ceasefire Talks with Russia
description: The United States has agreed to resume military aid to Ukraine, following talks that led Kyiv to accept a U.S. proposal for a 30-day ceasefire with Russia. While Ukraine anticipates further negotiations, the response from Moscow remains uncertain amid ongoing military actions on both sides.
